prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: an opaque 1024 by 1536 pixel portrait painted scenery background for the Split beer game.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target. Edit this actual image, preserving its identity rather than reimagining the place.
Primary request: make a Christmas/winter variation by changing only the seasonal environment, holiday lighting, and warm clothing described below.
Invariants: preserve the exact original viewpoint, composition, recognizable architecture, perspective, furniture positions, small friends in the same positions, full-bleed 2:3 framing, and richly painted gouache/pencil travel-postcard style. Keep the foreground tabletop geometry and its rear edge at exactly the same height as the original. The center of the foreground table must stay empty and clear because the game draws a live beer vessel there.
Seasonal changes: preserve this exact Grand Place Brussels café view at Christmas-market dusk, its town-hall spire, gilded guildhall facades, burgundy awnings, lamps, café furniture and the same small friends. Turn the existing wet cobblestones into a cold reflective square with restrained frost or light snow at its edges. Add a few small distant Christmas-market stalls along the far sides of the square, preserving the view down its center and all architectural outlines; their tiny warm lights echo the existing lanterns. A modest evergreen wreath hangs under the existing café awning. Keep the cream marble foreground tabletop and its rear edge identical, clear of all props and drinks.
Constraints: scenery only. No foreground glass, bottle, cup, mug, can, beer, drink, brand logo, lettering, signs, text, UI, watermark, border, or new foreground props. Preserve the original table surface and clear middle. No Santa, fantasy scenery, giant decorations, repeated decorative Christmas tree, or change of location. Warm holiday lights must remain small plausible details within the existing architecture.
inspection: Inspected original and generated edit. Same Grand Place architecture, spire, burgundy awnings, lamps, seated friends, chairs and clear marble table. Small distant market stalls, warm lights, wreath, and snow at square edges; architecture remains legible.
tableMeasurement: Visual inspection and strongest central 201-pixel row gradient at the tabletop rear edge.
